title: Better language models and their implications
summary: We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.
body: We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.
summaryZh: OpenAI训练了一个大规模的无监督语言模型，能够在不需要特定任务训练的情况下，生成连贯的文本段落，并在多项语言建模基准测试中达到SOTA水平，同时初步具备阅读理解、机器翻译、问答和摘要能力。原始信息显示：We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Better language models and their implications”。其重要性主要体现在：训练了大规模无监督语言模型并在多项基准上取得突破，是语言模型演进史上的重要里程碑。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
